desc:
⚒️ Forge your fortune—one hammer strike at a time!

Upgrade your sword, push your luck, and chase the perfect forge! Every strike could make your blade more valuable… or leave it in pieces. 💥

🍀 Collect lucky charms to boost your chances.
🔥 Enter Divine Forging for a powerful crafting burst.
💰 Sell your swords, earn gold, and pay your taxes.
🚪 Smash doors and collect extra scrap.
✨ Mix and match items to build your winning strategy!

Will you cash out—or risk one more strike? 🗡️
